privacy_and_segregability.statutory_boundary: 7 U.S.C. 1502(c)(1) protects producer-furnished information; 7 U.S.C. 1502(c)(2)(A) authorizes non-identifying statistical or aggregate disclosure.
privacy_and_segregability.non_guarantee: The statute permits qualifying disclosure but does not require creation of a new record or guarantee release of every requested field.

claim_guardrails: A request specification is not evidence that responsive records exist.
A released finding amount would not automatically be final debt.
A final administrative determination request would not establish reversal or affirmance.
Setoff would not automatically equal cash collection.
Raw sampled amounts would not automatically equal the weighted $579.36 million projection.
A collection amount without prevention attribution and control cost would not establish net savings.
A no-records response would establish only the result of the described search, not zero outcomes.
A denial or redaction would not establish that responsive records do not exist.
